non_activation_control.note: Under asteria-p4-full-context-control (retrieval_manifest.candidate_depth=1), only d2-classification-seg10 is retrieved and packed -- no CONDITION/EXCEPTION/CROSS_REFERENCE Tier-2 cue is present, so trace.segment_boundary_dependency_flags is empty and REP_SEGMENTATION_GRANULARITY_MISMATCH's trace-observable gate (TO_REP_SEG_boundary_flags) is VIOLATED -- verified directly against matching/eligibility.py::evaluate_eligibility, not asserted.

known_limitations: Under the default asteria-p1-baseline manifest (candidate_depth=5), the top-5 candidate pool also includes condition/cross-reference-bearing content from elsewhere in the corpus -- the non-activation control specifically requires the narrower asteria-p4-full-context-control manifest to isolate a genuinely clean packed set.
